ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Mercury

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
From {H:1802979065000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on friends and plans for the future. This is where your strength lies today.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
From {H:1802979065000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your career and your goals. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
From {H:1802979065000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
From {H:1802979065000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
From {H:1802979065000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on relationships and partnerships. It is a good day to start something in this area.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
From {H:1802979065000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on routine, daily work and health. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
From {H:1802979065000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
From {H:1802979065000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on home and family. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
From {H:1802979065000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
From {H:1802979065000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your money and what you value. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
From {H:1802979065000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.
